# Hutsix — Windows Automation Toolkit

> Hutsix is a Windows desktop automation platform built with Python and PySide6. It automates repetitive keyboard and mouse workflows through a visual, profile-based system with no coding required. Triggers (global hotkeys, pixel color, image match, OCR text) drive keyboard/mouse action sequences, with per-binding diagnostics, focus guard, cooldowns, and optional CUDA GPU acceleration for AI/vision workloads. Runs on Windows 10/11 (64-bit).

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- License: Proprietary software with a free 7-day trial
- The trial cannot be reset by reinstalling
- Typical usage is fully UI-driven (no coding required)
